payload.text: Home - Affinius Capital Skip to content Partners. Advisors. Investors. Stewards. Aligning with our global institutional clients’ objectives to create value and generate income for more than 40 years. Discover Affinius Purpose Driven We invest across the risk spectrum and capital stack for a global client base, managing a diverse portfolio of real assets across North America and Europe. Through our development, acquisition, and lending strategies, we align with our clients’ ambitions by providing capital solutions that empower thematic investing. View Our Philosophy News and Thoughts 2026 Responsible Investment Report United States Navigating the Uneven Multifamily Sector Transition Economy, Property Sectors, United States The Case for Bridge / Transitional Lending Economy, Market Trends, United States Why Macro Volatility is Changing Logistics Demand, Not Undermining It Economy, Europe, Market Trends, Property Sectors 2026 House View: European Property Market Outlook Economy, Europe, Market Trends, Property Sectors 2026 House View Economy, Market Trends, United States See All Progress Through Innovation With a steady mission to create value for our investors and their beneficiaries, we pursue exceptional ideas through constant evaluation of changing landscapes and drive the best concepts forward. Pioneering new strategies and improving upon current practices has been the foundation of our approach for 40+ years and paves the way for a more advanced and dynamic tomorrow. Strategic Focus Our strategies are purposefully flexible so we may recognize accelerating demand drivers and create value as market conditions shift. We provide strategic capital for thematic investing in the following diverse areas: - Technology-driven real estate assets, including data centers and industrial/logistics - Lending - Opportunistic investments - Housing - Foundational strategies Investment Management Our balanced approach to value creation and risk management throughout the entire investment lifecycle is complemented by a service-oriented culture which drives us to keep our investors informed of how their capital is working under our stewardship. Development With over four decades of development experience, our in-house expertise is bolstered by key partnerships with market participants across the globe. Acquisitions Our approach is a simple one: quality and basis matter. Focusing on quality within our investments and making those investments at the appropriate basis, lay the foundation upon which we create value. Lending Our cycle-tested lending platform serves as a one-stop capital source for owners and developers of high-quality, commercial real estate assets. Get in touch From informed guidance to strategic insights, we’re here to serve. Contact Us Join our team Our welcoming team is committed to partnership and we offer a dynamic, multi-faceted environment where careers thrive. View Openings Contact Close Manage Consent To provide the best experiences, we use t… [/about] About Us - Affinius Capital Our Foundation About Us - Affinius Capital Skip to content Our Foundation 1982 Inception Founded as the real estate investment arm of USAA. 2012 Expansion Formed joint venture with Square Mile Capital to expand debt and equity solutions, with 100% buyout completed in 2021. 2014 Global Reach Expanded business into Europe with establishment of Amsterdam office and acquisition of a majority interest in industrial/logistics development partner, Mountpark, with a 100% buyout completed in 2024. 2020 Ownership Restructure Management-led partnership acquires controlling interest in USAA Real Estate, positioning its leadership to participate in the ownership of the business and co-invest alongside investor clients. 2021 Corscale Data Centers Portfolio company formed to combine expertise and capital needed for quality execution of data center development for hyperscale clients. 2023 Same Team, New Name. Affinius Capital emerges from the integration of USAA Real Estate and Square Mile Capital, carrying forward our over 40+ year history of mission-driven purpose. TODAY Driven by Progress Pursuing what’s next and advancing emerging opportunities through our lending and equity initiatives. Our Mission To serve our clients by striving to place their interests above all else in pursuit of outstanding risk-adjusted returns. With disciplined execution, we aim to be the capital provider of choice to high-quality sponsors, while creating a rich and rewarding culture for our team. Core Values Integrity True to our word and ever mindful of how our actions effect partner, clients, their beneficiaries, and our team. Service Excellence in everything we do, elevating the needs of investors, partners, and each other with every decision we make. Innovation Pioneer new concepts and improve upon current practices to pave the way to a more advanced and dynamic tomorrow. Guiding Principles Transparency Open communication about what we do and why, including the actions and motivations around our challenges and successes. Curiosity Pursuit of exceptional ideas through our constant evaluation of changing landscapes and challenge to drive the best concepts forward. Authenticity True to our convictions, values and spirit, as we build and nurture relationships. Sustainability Responsible investment initiatives where we believe it makes good business sense. Alignment A relationship-driven philosophy that enables like-minded partners to invest alongside us in opportunities we find compelling. Diversity Celebration of diversity and inclusion in both thought and action, with a culture built on trust, respect and dignity for all. Community Involvement in the communities in which we invest and live by giving back our time, resources and ideas.
